bullets.title: Inside the Very Big, Very Controversial Business of Dog Cloning
bullets.creator: David Ewing Duncan
bullets.note: (Vanity Fair) by David Ewing Duncan ([@duncande](https://twitter.com/duncande?lang=en)). Ever lost a dog you loved, or do you fear losing a dog you currently love? This article digs into the business, science, and ethics of making a copy of Fido…

bullets.title: Sundale indoor/outdoor floor chair
bullets.note: I use this for morning meditation, and its ultra-lightweight design makes it a breeze to move and store. I face it out a bay window towards grass and trees, as I’ve started meditating with open eyes occasionally per instructions from [Sam Harris](https://samharris.org/).

bullets.title: Sam Maher - New York Handpan 01
bullets.note: I’d never heard handpan music quite like this, and I’d never seen someone use their thumbs so extensively with this instrument. I love it.

bullets.title: Tate’s Bake Shop ginger zinger cookies
bullets.note: I can polish off an entire bag of these gems on cheat day, and I’ll choose them over Tate’s chocolate chip cookies (which are excellent) any day. Side note: they are gluten-free. I’m glad I didn’t know that until I’d already become addicted, as I probably wouldn’t have given them a fair shot.
